event_chain.summary: Publishing error: SSNs exposed in public directory database

summary: The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services published a downloadable database behind its new Medicare provider directory that exposed the Social Security numbers of at least dozens of health care providers, which had been entered into the wrong fields by providers or their representatives and published without adequate validation. The data was publicly accessible for at least several weeks until The Washington Post flagged it to CMS on April 28, 2026.
